data.title: Are You Hungry?
data.statement:
You must find out how hungry you are by looking at the names of the previous foods you've eaten.

You will get [[n]] names of foods and your maximum food level [[max]].

For every [[food]], its first letter determines how many [[hungerPoints]] it is worth. A food whose name starts with A is worth 1 [[hungerPoints]], a food whose name starts with B is worth 2 [[hungerPoints]], and so on. Therefore, a food starting with Z is worth 26 [[hungerPoints]].

Your total [[hungerPoints]] is the sum of the values of all [[food]] names.

If [[hungerPoints]] ≤ {{20%}} of [[max]], output "{{starving...}}".

If {{20%}} of [[max]] < [[hungerPoints]] ≤ {{50%}} of [[max]], output "{{Yes, please!}}".

If {{50%}} of [[max]] < [[hungerPoints]] ≤ {{85%}} of [[max]], output "{{I wouldn't mind eating something.}}".

If {{85%}} of [[max]] < [[hungerPoints]] < [[max]], output "{{Just a little bit.}}".

If [[max]] ≤ [[hungerPoints]] ≤ {{115%}} of [[max]], output "{{No thanks, I'm full.}}".

If {{115%}} of [[max]] < [[hungerPoints]], output "{{BURSTING!!!}}".

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

You must find out how hungry you are by looking at the names of the previous foods you've eaten.

You will get n names of foods and your maximum food level max.

For every food, its first letter determines how many hungerPoints it is worth. A food whose name starts with A is worth 1 hungerPoints, a food whose name starts with B is worth 2 hungerPoints, and so on. Therefore, a food starting with Z is worth 26 hungerPoints.

Your total hungerPoints is the sum of the values of all food names.

If hungerPoints ≤ 20% of max, output "starving...".

If 20% of max < hungerPoints ≤ 50% of max, output "Yes, please!".

If 50% of max < hungerPoints ≤ 85% of max, output "I wouldn't mind eating something.".

If 85% of max < hungerPoints < max, output "Just a little bit.".

If max ≤ hungerPoints ≤ 115% of max, output "No thanks, I'm full.".

If 115% of max < hungerPoints, output "BURSTING!!!".
Input
Line 1: An integer n, the number of foods eaten.

Line 2: An integer max, your maximum food level.

Next n lines: A food name food. Each food consists of letters without spaces.
Output
Output the hunger status corresponding to your total hungerPoints:

- "starving..." if hungerPoints is at most 20% of max.
- "Yes, please!" if hungerPoints is greater than 20% and at most 50% of max.
- "I wouldn't mind eating something." if hungerPoints is greater than 50% and at most 85% of max.
- "Just a little bit." if hungerPoints is greater than 85% and less than max.
- "No thanks, I'm full." if hungerPoints is at least max and at most 115% of max.
- "BURSTING!!!" if hungerPoints is greater than 115% of max.
Constraints
0 < n ≤ 50
10 < max ≤ 200

food is a single word
The first letter of food is always capitalized
Example
Input
3
15
Apple
Bagel
CreamCheese
Output
Yes, please!
